      AI Overview
      Bobby Cannavale is known for his versatile roles in TV and film, including Emmy-winning performances in Boardwalk Empire and Will & Grace, major roles in Third Watch, Nurse Jackie, and Homecoming, alongside acclaimed films like Blue Jasmine, Ant-Man, and The Irishman, often playing tough or charismatic characters. He's recognized for both his dramatic depth and comedic timing in a wide range of projects.

      • Stage Actor:
        A respected stage actor with Tony nominations for plays like The Motherfker with the Hat and Mauritius.

        Adept at playing complex, physical roles as well as comedic characters, transitioning seamlessly between genres.
